source: Salvaged from the jarvis-desktop-48 worktree (identical base blobs, so a direct copy), then reviewed, fixed and completed here. Nothing outside the assigned paths was edited.

files.purpose: Store.forgetHistory + parseForgetHistory (IPC-safe); new ProductivityStore sidecar (productivity.json): capsule goals/references, checkpoints, focus history, reminder snooze/dismiss, opt-in application timeline, associations, file shelf, recents, retention policy. Atomic tmp+fsync+rename, serialized queue, rollback on failed write, corrupt-file quarantine with .prev restore, newer-version read-only.

Search over checkpoints, shelf, goals/references, opt-in history/chat/external records with project, tag, category and date filters; navResult; evidence-cited daily/resume recaps, worklog draft, association suggestions, reminder status/snooze helpers, focus observer/summary, retention preview.

previewRestore (dry run, never launches), previewGeometry, captureGeometry, portable capsule packs (exportCapsulePack, parseCapsulePack, mapPath) with {ROOT:name} tokens; imported packs carry no permissions.
ProjectMemory (goals, references, checkpoints, resume recap) and RestoreTools (preview, window capture, pack export/import) mounted in the capsule editor.
Ranked note search using the shared engine, copy text, 'referenced by capsule' hint.
FocusRecorder, focus history, reminder snooze/dismiss controls, calendar-today list.

Filters, history switch, non-linked rows, MemoryControls (timeline opt-in, retention preview, two-step forgetting). Falls back to the app store for sidecar data and shared signals when no props are passed.
ProductivityAPI type, productivity state, applyProductivity/refreshProductivity, useOptionalStore.
51 node:test cases bundling the real TypeScript with an in-memory file system.

fixesMadeDuringSalvage: effectiveReminderTasks reverted a snooze to its original due time once the snooze elapsed, so the scheduler never announced it (failing test). A snoozed task now keeps the snooze end as its due time; the unused nowMs parameter was removed.

search.ts widened SearchCategory beyond src/shared/contracts.ts, which broke typecheck in backend.ts, App.tsx and Home.tsx. searchState now has an overload: the original {includeChat, limit} call is typed with the four contract categories; MemorySearch passes onNavigate a contract-shaped NavResult via navResult. No contract or other-owner file was touched.
parseProductivity gave persisted goals/references without an id an empty-string id; it now treats that as damage and runs recovery.

MemorySearch ignored the sidecar when its callers (Home, Search view) passed no props, so checkpoints and shelf were never searched; it now reads the optional app store. A non-throwing useOptionalStore keeps standalone rendering working (tests/backend-search.test.mjs).
Store.forgetHistory now validates its input (booleans, date, at least one kind) because it will receive renderer data.

checks.detail: 528 tests, 526 pass. Failures: tests/autopilot-models.test.mjs 'cancelling mid-stream...' and 'cloud streaming parses SSE...' (chat.ts, models owner; already listed in docs/continuation-baseline.md). They use a fake store and do not load any file from this module.

electron/backend.ts(201) missing routines/models/integrations/usage/clipboard/system API methods, and src/shared/contracts.ts(1) RoutinePlan not exported from services/routines. Zero errors in owned files; previously search/contract errors in backend.ts:363, App.tsx:382, Home.tsx:228 are gone.
renderer bundles; no node: module reaches it (store/capsules are imported type-only from views).

validated.atomicWrites: Failed rename rolls memory back, removes the .tmp file and keeps the previous file (ProductivityStore and Store.forgetHistory); a leftover .tmp never replaces good data; 25 concurrent operations serialize with none lost.
validated.retention: ProductivityStore prunes on load and applyRetention per policy (0 = keep); Store drops chat/activity older than settings.retainDays on load and applyRetention while notes, tasks and capsules are untouched; previewRetention counts without changing anything.
validated.backups: Rotation keeps the newest 10, the newest of each of the last 7 days and 5 pre-import files; older ones are removed.
validated.recovery: Corrupt main state is quarantined and restored from the newest valid backup (a damaged newest backup is skipped) or reset with a visible activity entry; corrupt sidecar restores from .prev or resets; newer-version data is read-only and never overwritten.
validated.import: Main-state import keeps current mode, allowedRoots, approvedApps, localEndpoint and cloudModel and records what was ignored; capsule packs are validated item by item (UNC, traversal, relative, NUL, bad URL, unknown kind dropped), carry no approval, and are re-authorized per item by prepareItem at restore.

interfaces.rendererApi: src/ui/store.tsx ProductivityAPI, read from window.jarvis.productivity (not declared in contracts.ts; read by cast): get(): Promise<ProductivityState>; apply(op: ProductivityOp): Promise<ProductivityState>; forgetHistory?(opts: {chat?, activity?, before?}): Promise<{removed: {chat, activity}}>; capsule?: {previewRestore(id): Promise<RestorePreview>; listWindows?(): Promise<{hwnd, title, process}[]>; captureGeometry?(id, hwnds): Promise<{saved, skipped}>; exportPack?(id, roots: PathRoot[]): Promise<{saved, unmapped}>; readPack?(): Promise<string|null>; parsePack?(raw, mappings): Promise<PackImport>}; signals?(): Promise<ExternalDoc[]>. Every member is optional and the views say so when it is missing.

store.ts.Store: existing class, plus forgetHistory(raw: unknown): Promise<{state: AppState; removed: {chat: number; activity: number}}>
store.ts.parseForgetHistory: (raw: unknown) => {chat?: boolean; activity?: boolean; before?: string}
store.ts.ProductivityStore: new ProductivityStore({dir, fs?, now?, newId?, fileName? = 'productivity.json'}); load(): Promise<LoadResult>; snapshot(): ProductivityState; apply(raw: unknown): Promise<ProductivityState> (validated discriminated ProductivityOp, unknown ops rejected); reconcile({capsuleIds, taskIds}): Promise<ProductivityState>; applyRetention(): Promise<ProductivityState>; isReadOnly; statePath
exports: types ProductivityState, ProductivityOp, CapsuleMeta, Checkpoint, FocusSession, ReminderState, TimelineEntry, ShelfItem, RecentItem, MemoryPolicy

search.ts.searchState: (state, query, options?: BasicSearchOptions): NavResult[] and (state, query, options?: SearchOptions): SearchResult[]; SearchOptions adds includeHistory, productivity, external, categories, tag, capsuleId, since
search.ts.recaps: buildDailyRecap(state, prod, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), buildResumeRecap(state, prod, capsuleId), draftWorklog(recap, {withSources?}), suggestAssociations(subject, state, limit?)
search.ts.reminders: reminderStatus(task, states, nowMs), snoozeUntil('10m'|'1h'|'tomorrow', nowMs), effectiveReminderTasks(tasks, states)
search.ts.focus: observeFocus(prev, cur, nowMs) => {next, record}, focusSummary(sessions, sinceMs?), MIN_RECORDED_FOCUS_SEC=60

interfaces.capsules.ts: restoreCapsule(deps, id) unchanged; previewRestore({state, actions, native, selfPids}, id, displays?) => RestorePreview; previewGeometry(capsule, windows, selfPids, displays?); captureGeometry(windows, selectedHwnds, selfPids) => {windows, skipped}; exportCapsulePack(capsule, meta, roots?, now?) => {json, unmapped}; parseCapsulePack(raw, mappings?) => PackImport (saves nothing); mapPath; PACK_FORMAT='jarvis-capsule-pack'; PACK_LIMITS
interfaces.views: ProjectMemory and RestoreTools (mounted in Capsules.tsx); FocusRecorder (mounted in Tasks.tsx); exported MemorySearch (props: state, onNavigate(NavResult), initialQuery?, limit?, productivity?, external?) and MemoryControls (no props, reads useReady)

captainWiring: Main process: create ProductivityStore({dir: userData}), await load(), surface a returned warning, and expose it as window.jarvis.productivity through a preload IPC bridge with sender validation (apply must pass the raw payload to ProductivityStore.apply; forgetHistory to Store.forgetHistory).
Main process: call ProductivityStore.reconcile({capsuleIds, taskIds}) after note/task/capsule deletes and after Store.importDocument.
Main process: feed Reminders with () => effectiveReminderTasks(state.tasks, productivity.reminders) and call rearm() after reminder.snooze/dismiss/clear so a snooze announces again when it ends.

Main process (capsule API): previewRestore with the real ActionService and NativeAdapter; listWindows/captureGeometry (use captureGeometry() then save via the validated saveCapsule path); exportPack/readPack behind trusted native save/open dialogs (readPack at most 1 MB); parsePack = parseCapsulePack. Imported packs must still be saved through the normal validated capsule save.
Main process: Store.backup('pre-import') already runs inside importDocument; nothing else needed for imports.

Renderer shell: mount <FocusRecorder /> once at app level (inside the focus provider) so sessions are recorded on every view; today it only runs while the Tasks view is open. Mount <MemoryControls /> in Settings (it is not mounted anywhere yet). Home.tsx and App.tsx need no change for search: onNavigate now receives the four contract categories.
searchState with the original {includeChat, limit} options keeps returning contract SearchResult[]; electron/backend.ts needs no change for search.
limitations: Not wired in main/preload: window.jarvis.productivity does not exist yet, so in the current tree every productivity feature shows 'not connected' and nothing is saved for it. Chat/activity forgetting and memory search over notes/tasks/capsules work without it.

Shelf, recents, application timeline and session associations have storage, validation, search and forgetting but no add/edit UI, and nothing in the app reports timeline sessions; the timeline stays off by default and empty until a module reports sessions with the user's opt-in.
Focus sessions are recorded only while FocusRecorder is mounted (Tasks view) until the captain moves it to the shell.
Screen history and meeting/system-audio capture (roadmap 39, 40) and deep app-state restoration and spatial map (49, 50) are not implemented; the UI marks them unavailable and nothing is captured.
Recaps and worklog drafts are assembled from stored records, with a cited source per line; no model is used, so they are deliberately plain.
Association suggestions are word overlap only and never applied without user confirmation.

Tests use an in-memory file system, so real Windows EPERM/EBUSY rename retry timing and fsync are simulated, not exercised on disk. Views are tested through static markup (what is rendered and hidden), not through click or keyboard events.
Backups of the main state may still hold chat/activity forgotten later until they rotate out; the Forget panel says so.
Remaining failures are outside this module: 2 models-owner tests and 2 typecheck errors (backend.ts API methods, RoutinePlan export).
